name: HierText
description: We organize a competition on hierarchical text detection and recognition. The competition is aimed to promote research into deep learning models and systems that can jointly perform text detection and recognition and geometric layout analysis. We present details of the proposed competition organization, including tasks, datasets, evaluations, and schedule. During the competition period (from January 2nd 2023 to April 1st 2023), at least 50 submissions from more than 20 teams were made in the 2 proposed tasks. Considering the number of teams and submissions, we conclude that the HierText competition has been successfully held. In this report, we will also present the competition results and insights from them.
reputation: A well-known OCR/text-understanding competition benchmark that has attracted many teams and submissions in hierarchical text detection and recognition.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; performance is typically reported with detection/recognition F1-style metrics and may vary across the two competition tasks.
